title: Nyāyasūtra with Vācaspati Miśra’s Tātparyaṭīkā
author: Vācaspati Miśra (10th century), on Uddyotakara’s Nyāyavārttika
blurb: Vācaspati’s ‘commentary on the purport’ of the Vārttika, the great defence of Nyāya against the Buddhist logicians, set out under each sūtra of Gautama.
source: GRETIL e-text, input by members of the SANSKNET project and checked against the edition of Anantalal Thakur (New Delhi, 1996). The e-text was converted from a Devanagari encoding, so many word boundaries are not marked by spaces, and it has not been fully proof-read. Page and line references to the Vārttika were removed.
caution: This e-text has not been fully proof-read, and many words run together as they would in a Devanagari print. Expect more misprints, and more uncertain analyses, than in the Bhāṣya.

nav: prāpya sādhyamaprāpya vā hetoḥ prāptyāviśiṣṭatvād aprāptyāsādhakatvācca prāptyaprāptisamau
साधर्म्यात्संशये न संशयो वैधर्म्यादुभयथा वा संशयेऽत्यन्तसंशयप्रसङ्गो नित्यत्वानभ्युपगमाच्च सामान्यस्याप्रतिषेधः
sādharmyātsaṃśaye na saṃśayo vaidharmyād ubhayathā vā saṃśaye 'tyantasaṃśayaprasaṅgo nityatvānabhyupagamācca sāmānyasyāpratiṣedhaḥ
दृष्टान्ते च साध्यसाधनभावेन प्रज्ञातस्य धर्मस्य हेतुत्वात्तस्य चोभयथा भावान्नाविशेषः
dṛṣṭānte ca sādhyasādhanabhāvena prajñātasya dharmasya hetutvāttasya cobhayathā bhāvānnāviśeṣaḥ
प्रतिषेधं सदोषमभ्युपेत्य प्रतिषेधविप्रतिषेधे समानो दोषप्रसङ्गो मतानुज्ञा
pratiṣedhaṃ sadoṣamabhyupetya pratiṣedhavipratiṣedhe samāno doṣaprasaṅgo matānujñā

nav: प्रतिज्ञाहानिः प्रतिज्ञान्तरं प्रतिज्ञाविरोधः प्रतिज्ञासंन्यासो हेत्वन्तरमर्थान्तरं निरर्थकमविज्ञातार्थमपार्थकमप्राप्तकालं न्यूनमधिकं पुनरुक्तमननुभाषणमज्ञानमप्रतिभा विक्षेपो मतानुज्ञा पर्यनुयोज्योपेक्षणं निरनुयोज्यानुयोगोपसिद्धान्तो हेत्वाभासाश्च निग्रहस्थानानि
